calendar_contract.basis: month+half anchors, not career turn numbers
calendar_contract.reason: No source publishes the career turn a Unity Cup team race falls on (SCENARIO-PUBLISHER-REFERENCES.md:1186 records that as UNVERIFIED). scenario_slots stores month+half, so the anchors are the only citable position. Turn mapping is left to the established career calendar (09-global-race-calendar.md: (month-1)*2+half within a 24-turn year).

evidence_limitations: Each team race is a set of 5 races drawn at random from a fixed pool; the courses, distances, surfaces and opponents for a given set are per-run values only the client shows. No per-leg detail is stored here.
The five categories are Sprint, Mile, Medium, Long, Dirt (docs/scenarios/02-unity-cup.md:149).
Opponent team names other than the scripted Team Zenith finals opponent are not published per round and are not stored.
No historical per-round outcome is stored here; outcomes are per-run Trainer observations (see D-10).

rows.title: Team Race Round 1
rows.description: First team race, held after Junior Year Late December. A set of five races, one per category (Sprint, Mile, Medium, Long, Dirt).

rows.title: Team Race Round 2
rows.description: Second team race, held after Classic Year Late June. A set of five races, one per category.

rows.title: Team Race Round 3
rows.description: Third team race, held after Classic Year Late December. A set of five races, one per category.

rows.title: Team Race Round 4
rows.description: Fourth team race, held after Senior Year Late June. A set of five races, one per category. An Elite Team can appear here under the rework conditions.

rows.title: Unity Cup Finals
rows.description: The finals, held after Senior Year Late December. A set of five races, one per category, against the scripted Team Zenith (or a strengthened variant if unlocked).
